premises.text: Insect hatchery/incubator process yields market-ready fertilizer and dried insect protein powder

premises.text: Companies pay for waste removal while Natransa also sells protein and fertilizer

premises.text: Compared with plant-based, cultured meat, and crickets, their insect route is more scalable and cost-competitive with meat

premises.text: Pet market entry first, then human alternative-protein segments including athletes and patients who cannot digest regular meat
